Apocalyptic Shadow Analytics (4.3.1 — Gale of Forgetting)

Information and analytics about the current and past Apocalyptic Shadow phases!

Last updated: 25/June/2026

Apocalyptic Shadow Analytics

If you have any suggestions about the contents of this page, contact our analyst on Discord (username: lvlurarti) or Reddit (username: LvlUrArti). Also, if you want to see the raw data we have gathered, you can find it on the MocStats GitHub repository.

Help us!

Help us make the Analytics better!

You just need to share your UID to help us. It's so simple!

If you want to share your Apocalyptic Shadow clear information with us, you simply need to fill the form below and provide us with your UID and make your Hoyo profile public - we will automatically parse the MoC clear information from your profile after that! The more people join the project, the better and more accurate data we can provide!

Apocalyptic Shadow Stats Form

Average score 4.3.1 — Gale of Forgetting

Disclaimer: Don't use the data to compare the pull value between characters. There are a lot that factors in appearance rate, such as the memory turbulence and enemy lineup.

For more accurate assessment, check our tier list and the character reviews.

Additional information
  • The data has been last updated on 25/June/2026.
  • 15624 players shared their 4.3.1 — Gale of Forgetting Apocalyptic Shadow clear data with us. Sources:
    • Prydwen - 7684
    • StarDB - 4170
    • HoyoBuddy - 1755
    • Random - 3407
  • The data only includes characters information based on the usage in AS stage 4.
  • Currently the average cycle clear takes into account both sides - sadly the API is pretty limited and we have no way to obtain the average cycle per 1 side currently.
  • If the data for a character is skewed (|γ1| > 0.8), trimmed mean is used instead of mean. It calculates the average after excluding the highest 25% and lowest 25% of scores.

Character usage 4.3.1 — Gale of Forgetting

Disclaimer: Don't use the data to compare the pull value between characters. There are a lot that factors in appearance rate, such as the memory turbulence and enemy lineup.

For more accurate assessment, check our tier list and the character reviews.

Additional information
  • The data has been last updated on 25/June/2026.
  • 15624 players shared their 4.3.1 — Gale of Forgetting Apocalyptic Shadow clear data with us. Sources:
    • Prydwen - 7684
    • StarDB - 4170
    • HoyoBuddy - 1755
    • Random - 3407
  • The data only includes characters information based on the usage in AS stage 4.
  • Characters are ranked with appearance rate, which is how often a character was used by all players, regardless of whether they own the character or not. Ownership rate currently cannot be obtained.
  • If the data for a character is skewed (|γ1| > 0.8), trimmed mean is used instead of mean. It calculates the average after excluding the highest 25% and lowest 25% of scores.

Character usage over time

The table below shows the average performance and usage rate in the last 3 phases of Apocalyptic Shadow - so what's being taken into account for the purpose of our tier list. We don't just look at the last phase data because the buffs and enemy layout heavily impact performance of some characters. Keep in mind that sometimes the data can be skewed - for example high usage rate usually negatively impacts the character cycles and the opposite also happens when a character isn't that popular, but performs above expectations thanks to dedicated fans. We don't take the data at face value, but further correlate it with our testing to get a better picture of which characters make clearing MoC easier.

Characters with * behind the data only have 1 phase worth of data, so they are pretty skewed.

Team usage (4.3.1 — Gale of Forgetting)

Disclaimer: Don't use the data to compare the pull value between characters. There are a lot that factors in appearance rate, such as the memory turbulence and enemy lineup.

For more accurate assessment, check our tier list and the character reviews.

Additional information
  • The data has been last updated on 25/June/2026.
  • 15624 players shared their 4.3.1 — Gale of Forgetting Apocalyptic Shadow clear data with us. Sources:
    • Prydwen - 7684
    • StarDB - 4170
    • HoyoBuddy - 1755
    • Random - 3407
  • The data only includes characters information based on the usage in AS stage 4.
  • If a team used a limited 5* E1+ character, it was excluded from the average cycles calculation.
  • The data includes all Light Cones - if you want to compare Signature vs Free options, go to the profile of a character as there we post detailed breakpoints.
  • If the data for a character is skewed (|γ1| > 0.8), trimmed mean is used instead of mean. It calculates the average after excluding the highest 25% and lowest 25% of scores.
  • The % number below the Rank are calculated per stage.
